for.markdownDescription: Materialization scope. `each_player` instantiates one ruleset per player and binds actor-anchored views (kill, damage_dealt, ...) to that player; `match` is one instance for the whole demo with no implicit player binding.

exports.markdownDescription: The stat/highlight ids this ruleset exports for cross-ruleset `ruleset.stat` reads. Omit to export everything (advisory lint only); list a subset to make the rest private — a qualified read of an unexported id is a not-exported error.

catalog_version.markdownDescription: Provenance field pinning the catalog a blueprint was authored against. Free-form human/tooling metadata: accepted and stored, never a build input.

expression.markdownDescription: A v2 expression (docs/rules-v2/rules-v2-spec.md). Resolves against the slot's scope: `event.*` fields, per-player providers `player.*`, B5 role handles `victim.*` / `killer.*` / `assister.*` under event views, `round.*` / `match.*` contexts, sibling stats (bare), `this`, and cross-ruleset `ruleset.stat`. Duration literals `10s` / `0.5s` / `500ms` are live. Closed function set: min, max, abs, contains, startswith. Map-valued `define:` lookups `ref[key]` (value | null) are live. B6 team aggregates are live: `round.team.alive` / `round.team.players` / `round.enemies.alive` / `round.enemies.players` (int, subject-relative alive/connected counts, disconnect-aware), `round.team.equipment` / `round.enemies.equipment` (int, freeze-end team economy sums) and `round.alive.in_clutch` (bool); read them in `when:` / `while:` / `compute:`. The `player.*` / `match.*` entity reads are enumerated with their types, units and caveats in `$defs/providerRead` - read the caveat before thresholding one: several are raw engine accumulators, not quantities.

providerRead.markdownDescription: An entity-value provider read. GENERATED from the catalog's providers family: these are the `player.*` and `match.*` names a rule expression may read off the entity state, with the unit and the caveat each one carries.

oneOf.markdownDescription: `match.bomb_planted` (type `bool`) - an entity read, from `entity.game.bomb_planted`. True from the frame the bomb is planted, and cleared by a defuse as well as at round_officially_ended, so it is not "the bomb was planted this round": that is `round.bomb.was_planted`, which stays true to the round's end.
`match.freeze_period` (type `bool`) - an entity read, from `entity.game.freeze_period`.

`match.game_phase` (type `int`) - an entity read, from `entity.game.game_phase`. The match phase. Measured on matchmaking demos: 2 through the first half, 4 over the halftime break, 3 through the second half, 5 once the match is over.

`match.round_time` (type `int`, in seconds) - an entity read, from `entity.game.round_time`. The length the round is configured to run, not a countdown: 115 in a live matchmaking round, 999 during warmup.

`match.round_win_reason` (type `int`) - an entity read, from `entity.game.round_win_reason`. The engine's round-end reason, set with round_win_status and cleared with it: 7 bomb defused, 8 counter-terrorists eliminated the terrorists, 9 terrorists eliminated the counter-terrorists, 12 target saved (time ran out). 0 while the round is undecided. Read it between the decision and the round's close, never on round_officially_ended, where it has already reset to 0.

`match.round_win_status` (type `int`) - an entity read, from `entity.game.round_win_status`. 0 while the round is undecided, 2 once the terrorists have won it, 3 once the counter-terrorists have. It goes 0 to 2/3 on the frame the round is decided and back to 0 at round_officially_ended, 448 ticks later on matchmaking demos, so on round_officially_ended it reads 0. At the round's close the winner is `enrich.round.winner_side`.

`match.total_rounds_played` (type `int`) - an entity read, from `entity.game.total_rounds_played`. Rounds decided so far this match: 0 before round 1, and it increments on the frame a round is decided, not when the next one starts.
`player.active_weapon_class` (type `string`) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.active_weapon_class`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event.
`player.active_weapon_clip` (type `int`) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.active_weapon_clip`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event.
`player.armor` (type `int`) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.armor`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event.

`player.duck_amount` (type `float`, in fraction) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.duck_amount`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event. Continuous over 0..1, not a flag: it ramps across the crouch transition, so a threshold on it reads as "how far into the crouch", not "is crouching".
`player.equipment_value` (type `int`) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.equipment_value`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event.

`player.eye_pitch` (type `float`, in degrees) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.eye_pitch`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event. CS2's convention: NEGATIVE is up. Wraps, so subtract two of these only after normalising the difference.

`player.eye_yaw` (type `float`, in degrees) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.eye_yaw`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event. Counter-clockwise from world +X, and it wraps at 360, so subtract two of these only after normalising the difference.

`player.flash_duration` (type `float`, in seconds) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.flash_duration`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event. The duration the server LATCHED for the flash, not a countdown: probed on the bundled GOTV sample it holds one value for the whole blind and then steps to 0, and the step is about 1.4x the latched value after the flash, so it never reads as "time still blind". Use `> 0` for "is blinded"; a magnitude test on it measures the flash, not what is left of it.
`player.health` (type `int`) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.health`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event.
`player.is_scoped` (type `bool`) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.is_scoped`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event.

`player.max_speed` (type `float`, in units/second) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.max_speed`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event. Per-weapon (an AWP out caps far lower than a knife), which is what makes it the denominator of a counter-strafe test rather than a fixed speed.
`player.place` (type `string`) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.place`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event.
`player.pos_x` (type `float`) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.pos_x`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event.
`player.pos_y` (type `float`) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.pos_y`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event.
`player.pos_z` (type `float`) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.pos_z`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event.

`player.punch_pitch` (type `float`, in degrees) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.punch_pitch`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event. NOT USABLE AS RECOIL TODAY. It is the raw aim-punch spring sample, correct only at its own base tick, and on the bundled GOTV sample it does not decode to degrees of punch at all: the two components cluster near -94 and +89, which no weapon's kick reaches. The engine's own consumer rejects every value outside +/-45 for that reason. A threshold on this column is true on nearly every tick and means nothing about recoil.

`player.punch_yaw` (type `float`, in degrees) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.punch_yaw`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event. NOT USABLE AS RECOIL TODAY, for the reasons under `player.punch_pitch`: same raw spring sample, same undecoded cluster on the bundled sample, same rejection by the engine's own consumer.

`player.shots_fired` (type `int`, in shots) - an entity read, from `entity.pawn.shots_fired`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event. Position within the CURRENT burst, not a round or match total: it resets on trigger release and on weapon change.

`player.weapon_accuracy_penalty` (type `float`) - an entity read, from `entity.weapon.accuracy_penalty`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event. A raw engine accumulator in no unit, scaled per weapon: the same number means a different spread on a Deagle and on a Negev, so compare it within one weapon and never across two. It also excludes the movement term, so a running player's shot is more inaccurate than this says. For the movement term itself, ask the `shot_landed` view instead: its counter-strafe facets are lowered from `bullet_damage.InaccuracyMove`, which is the penalty the server actually charged the shot, and no entity read can better it. This column is the accumulator as it stood BEFORE the frame, which is the only answer available on a demo that emits no `bullet_damage` and the only one available at all for a shot that missed.

`player.weapon_recoil_index` (type `float`) - an entity read, from `entity.weapon.recoil_index`. Read at a rule site from the frame BEFORE the triggering event. A raw engine accumulator in no unit, scaled per weapon. Its useful property is that it rises within a spray and falls between sprays (a run over which it never drops is one spray), not its absolute magnitude, which is not comparable across weapons. Not the same number as the `recoil_index` FACET on `shot_landed`: that one is `bullet_damage.RecoilIndex`, the index the server fired the shot at, and is authoritative for "what did this shot fire at". This column is the entity read as it stood BEFORE the frame, so it answers "where was the spray up to when the shot site fired" and is the only answer on a demo carrying no `bullet_damage` or for a shot that missed. Do not pool the two in one stat.

actor.markdownDescription: Suppresses the view's implicit per-player actor binding (compiler-plan decision 3). `any` is the only value live in v2.0.

trigger.description: The map form of a trigger (a define body or off: block): on/match/where/while.

while.markdownDescription: A gate: a single round/match context or sibling flag reference.

offTrigger.markdownDescription: A deactivate trigger for a flag (live in v2.0): a bare view/define ref, or the map trigger form.

param.description: A named parameter bound to a literal at build (spec §5).

default.description: Default value; must match the declared type.

defineBody.markdownDescription: A define body: a list (`in` operand), a trigger (map with `on:`), an expression (string), or a string-keyed lookup **map** read via `ref[key]` (a miss yields `null`). A map's values must be uniform — all numbers or all strings.

oneOf.description: A list define: scalar literals used as an `in` operand.

oneOf.markdownDescription: A map define: a string-keyed lookup table (`weapon_class: {ak47: rifle, awp: sniper}`), read via `ref[key]` → value | null. Values must be all numbers or all strings.

stat.markdownDescription: One stat = one graph node. Declare exactly one kind: flag / count / sum / capture / compute / tally / streak / bucket / rate.

flag.markdownDescription: `flag: true` (a bool set by `on:`, optionally cleared by `off:`) or `flag: { when: <expr> }` (a bool auto-computed from sibling stats).

when.markdownDescription: A boolean condition. Either a single expression, or a **list** of expressions read as their AND-conjunction (`[a, b]` ≡ `(a) and (b)`) — a convenience for declaring each input on its own line. A single-item list equals the bare expression.

count.markdownDescription: A counter incremented on each fire of the referenced trigger or flag rising edge.

sum.markdownDescription: A running total: the value selector is added on each triggering event.

capture.markdownDescription: Captures a value on each triggering event; `keep:` chooses first / last / list / min / max.

compute.markdownDescription: A formula over sibling stats. `compute: "<expr>"` evaluates once at round end. `compute: { value: "<expr>", live: true }` opts into live cadence: it re-evaluates during the round as its reads change, so downstream reads and the timeline see the current value, not only the round-end one. A live compute recomputes at most once per evaluated message (its value is memoized between recomputes).

live.markdownDescription: Opt into live cadence: re-evaluate the formula during the round as its reads change, instead of once at round end. Defaults to false (round-end).

tally.markdownDescription: A threshold tally: reads a sibling value source (the kind value) and, at round end, increments the first `thresholds:` bucket whose `min` the source meets (highest min first).

streak.markdownDescription: A windowed streak counter over the referenced trigger's events: consecutive events within `window:` extend a streak; a streak of at least `min_streak:` increments the count.

bucket.markdownDescription: A per-key counter over the referenced trigger's events, keyed by `key:` (a single expression or a list of them → a composite/tuple key). The `reduce:` reducer folds each key: `count` (+1 per event, the default without `value:`), or over a `value:` amount `sum` (the default with `value:`), `min`, `max`, `last`, or `first`. Match-scoped and sampled per-game.

rate.markdownDescription: A per-key ratio (G3) over two same-keyed sibling `bucket:` stats: `of` (numerator) / `per` (denominator), evaluated per denominator key. Output iterates the DENOMINATOR key set (a rate is defined only where the population base exists); a numerator-missing key is `0 / denom = 0.0` (a real row); a denominator key that is 0 is skipped (undefined ratio). Both buckets must key on identical `key:` parts. Match-scoped and sampled per-game.

of.markdownDescription: The numerator bucket stat id (per-key numerators).

per.markdownDescription: The denominator bucket stat id — its key set is the output population base.

min.description: Inclusive minimum source value that activates this bucket - an integer literal, or a `params.<name>` reference to a bound int param (resolved to its literal value before hashing).

target.description: Id of the counter node this bucket increments when it wins.

thresholds.markdownDescription: tally: ordered `{ min, target }` threshold buckets (the highest matching min wins).

window.markdownDescription: streak: the maximum gap between consecutive events for the streak to extend - an integer tick count, a duration literal (`10s`, `640ms`), or the `"m:ss[.frac]"` clock form (`"1:30"` = 90s). Durations fold at the context tick rate. Defaults to 640 ticks.

min_streak.markdownDescription: streak: the minimum streak length that counts as a completed streak. Defaults to 2.

key.markdownDescription: bucket: the key selecting the per-event bucket, e.g. `event.Weapon` (must yield a string). A list of expressions forms an ordered composite/tuple key, e.g. `[event.Weapon, event.WeaponItemId]` (order is identity-bearing).

value.markdownDescription: bucket: the per-event numeric amount the reducer folds into the key, e.g. `enrich.hurt.capped_damage`. Required by `sum`/`min`/`max`/`last`/`first`; omit it for a `count` bucket (+1 per event). Defaults the reducer to `sum` when present, `count` when absent.

reduce.markdownDescription: bucket: the per-key reducer. `count` (+1 per event, no `value:`) or, over a `value:` amount, `sum` / `min` / `max` / `last` / `first`. Defaults to `sum` when `value:` is present, else `count`.

per.description: Reset scope: round-scoped (reset each round) or match-scoped.

keep.markdownDescription: Capture keep policy (only valid under `capture:`). `list` yields a collection; `min` / `max` keep the running extremum of a numeric value over the window.

while.markdownDescription: A gate: fire only while a round/match context or sibling flag is active.

format.description: compute: display format — a .NET numeric format string (e.g. `F2`, `F0`) applied when rendering the computed value. Defaults to `F1`. Presentation only: outside node identity (two computes differing only in `format:` dedup).

for_each.markdownDescription: Template expansion: multiplies the stat over each axis, substituting `{key}` into ids, expressions, labels, and titles (live in v2.0).

defaultSnippets.description: A round-end formula over sibling stats.

defaultSnippets.label: threshold tally
defaultSnippets.description: Tally a sibling value into min/target buckets at round end.

defaultSnippets.label: windowed streak
defaultSnippets.description: Count streaks of events within a tick window.

defaultSnippets.label: per-key sum bucket
defaultSnippets.description: A per-key SUM (e.g. damage per weapon).

defaultSnippets.label: per-key rate
defaultSnippets.description: A per-key ratio of two same-keyed buckets (e.g. headshot % per weapon).

highlight.markdownDescription: A rising-edge achievement: when `when:` first becomes true it emits a timeline event and increments an auto match-scoped `<id>.count`.

when.markdownDescription: A boolean condition. Either a single expression, or a **list** of expressions read as their AND-conjunction (`[a, b]` ≡ `(a) and (b)`) — a convenience for declaring each input on its own line. A single-item list equals the bare expression.

per.description: The rising-edge scope (the .count node is always match-scoped).

title.markdownDescription: A `{hole}` template rendered on fire, e.g. `{player.name} - {kills} kills`.

score.description: Base ranking weight (0-100) folding rarity and coolness; the reel surfaces higher-scored firings first. Defaults to 50.

kind.description: The editorial track this firing belongs to: a skill highlight (default), a funny moment, or a lowlight; each routes into its reel. Use 'hidden' for a counting-only round flag whose .count feeds a rating/stat (e.g. a KAST round) but which is never shown in any reel.

group.markdownDescription: A supersession family. Firings that share a `group:` are collapsed at the surfacing layer to the single highest-`score:` one per player+round, so a tiered family (e.g. `3K`/`4K`/`ace` all tagged `group: multikill`) surfaces only its top tier instead of every threshold it crossed. Omit for a standalone highlight.

show.description: The single surfacing block (compiler-plan §7): scoreboard columns + custom export tables.

scoreboard.description: Stat/highlight refs surfaced as scoreboard columns.

tables.description: Custom export tables keyed by name.

stat.markdownDescription: A stat id, or a highlight ref (`<id>` / `<id>.count`) which surfaces the match-scoped count.

label.description: Column header (defaults to the stat ref).

group.description: Display group the UI clusters columns under.

boards.markdownDescription: Override the per:-inferred board(s). Omit to default from the stat's scope.

as.markdownDescription: Display formatting for a tick-valued column: `ticks` = raw integer ticks, `seconds` = ticks / tick-rate, `time` = `m:ss` at the tick rate. Omit for the raw value.

per.description: The export dimension (the closed table registry). `player_round` / `player_match` are per-player (for: each_player); `match` is a single match-level row (for: match).

stat.description: A stat id, or a highlight ref binding to its per-round fired state.

label.description: Column header (defaults to the stat ref).

as.markdownDescription: Display formatting for a tick-valued column: `ticks` = raw integer ticks, `seconds` = ticks / tick-rate, `time` = `m:ss` at the tick rate. Omit for the raw value.
